verdict.rationale:
Mixpanel ships a hosted MCP server explicitly designed for AI assistants to query events, funnels, retention, and replays via natural language, plus a REST Query API for programmatic access to the same data (events, cohorts, user profiles). This directly matches the story of an agent answering growth questions from live data via API or MCP.

missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that the MCP server reliably answers complex growth questions in practice, and benchmarks on query latency/accuracy for live data.
